name: Inbox Zero
tagline: Keeps Gmail at zero by filing the noise every weekday
description: Works through Gmail on weekday mornings, archiving newsletters and notifications and filing receipts, notes and documents where they belong. What is left unread is the mail that genuinely needs a reply. Give it a day or two to learn your habits first.
author: zapnocode
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
